proof_body:
by
  intro X _ σ a b
  ext x
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  by_cases h1 : x = σ a
  · subst h1; simp
  by_cases h2 : x = σ b
  · subst h2; simp
  have h3 : σ⁻¹ x ≠ a := fun h => h1 (by rw [← h]; simp)
  have h4 : σ⁻¹ x ≠ b := fun h => h2 (by rw [← h]; simp)
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h3 h4, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h1 h2]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (X : Type*) [DecidableEq X] (σ : Equiv.Perm X) (a b : X), σ * Equiv.swap a b * σ⁻¹ = Equiv.swap (σ a) (σ b)
